summary: Claiborne County, MS: lattice observation tower east of Peyton. Only OpenStreetMap and Wikipedia found; no build, staffing or current-status record.

evidence.quote: The Peyton Lookout Tower is located east of the settlement.

evidence.supports: Peyton is an unincorporated community in Claiborne County
evidence.quote: Peyton is an unincorporated community in Claiborne County, Mississippi
Peyton had a post office from 1900 to 1935.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. Sources: the OSM node (tags: lattice, observation; ele 126; last edited over a year ago) and the Wikipedia article on Peyton, which says the tower lies east of the settlement and cites the USGS GNIS. Cached OSM data gives gnis:feature_id 711289 for the tower; the GNIS summary pages are JavaScript-only and could not be read. A state public-lands list dated July 29, 2020 includes a 'Claiborne County Tower and Work Center' entry; it names no town, so it is not linked to this record. Two WebSearch calls turned up no build date, builder, staffing or fire history. Record status and access are both unknown and the story says so. The story is about 85 words, below the usual 120-word floor, because the evidence is thin. Page-read budget was exceeded (about 8 fetches, including repeats that returned little).
